description: Read the captured renderer console output for the session, newest-relevant entries last. Filters (all optional, ANDed): type (one or more of log/info/warning/error/debug/...), match (a regular expression the text must match), since (epoch ms — only entries at/after it), limit (max entries, default 200, max 1000 — the most recent are kept). Returns: { ok, session_id, entries: [{ type, text, timestamp, windowId?, location? }], count, overflowed }. overflowed is the number of older entries the buffer dropped. Errors: NOT_RUNNING, BAD_ARGUMENT (invalid regex, or multiple sessions).

limit.description: Max entries to return (default 200, max 1000); keeps the most recent.

match.description: Regular expression the entry text must match.

sessionId.description: Target session id. Omit when a single session is running.

since.description: Only entries with timestamp >= this (epoch ms).

type.description: Console level(s) to include, e.g. "error" or ["warning", "error"].

name: electron_console_logs
title: Read console logs
